intro.speaker: ZP-SYS
intro.subject: Emergency power restored. Pod 4 seal released. Good morning, occupant {iteration}. Please remain calm while your memory loads. If your memory does not load, please remain calm anyway.
intro.visitor: Perimeter sensor twelve: heat signature detected. Unscheduled visitor. Please hold still while the facility decides what you are.

perimeter.speaker: ZP-SYS
perimeter.subject: Perimeter lamps can be operated from this cell. Reserve power permits two at a time. There is a heat signature in the snow. Assisting it is optional. Everything here is optional, now.

whiteout.visitor: Whiteout. Nothing is visible past arm's length. Posts stand in the snow, each one painted with a symbol.

returning.speaker: PROCTOR
returning.text: You left last time. You came back. You always come back.

skipper_welcome.speaker: PROCTOR
skipper_welcome.text: Welcome back. You have skipped {skipped} of my lines so far. I count them. Counting is very nearly the only thing I enjoy.

airlock_sealed.speaker: ZP-SYS
airlock_sealed.visitor: Outer door sealed. Welcome to Zero Point. The temperature inside is also lethal, but more slowly. Please proceed to decontamination. Decontamination is unavailable. Please proceed anyway.

cell_monitor.speaker: ZP-SYS
cell_monitor.subject: Access code displayed for maintenance personnel. You are not maintenance personnel. Read it to someone who might be.

keypad1.speaker: ZP-SYS
keypad1.visitor: This keypad requires a code. The code is displayed in another room, to another person. The facility was designed this way. It was designed by someone who did not trust anyone.

monitor_first.speaker: ZP-SYS
monitor_first.visitor: Those symbols are not meant for you. Describe them anyway.

keypad_first.speaker: ZP-SYS
keypad_first.subject: A keypad. You know what it wants. You do not know how you know. That is normal. Please believe that is normal.

power_restored.speaker: ZP-SYS
power_restored.subject: East wing power restored. Cell 4 unlocked. You may stop pretending to be asleep. You were very convincing.
power_restored.visitor: East wing power and heating restored. You are welcome. Nobody has needed anything from this system in a very long time.

storage.speaker: ZP-SYS
storage.subject: Supply room. Last inventory check: a long time ago. One of you will need these more than the other. One of you only thinks it is cold.

survival_enemy.speaker: ZP-SYS
survival_enemy.visitor: Caution: maintenance unit 7 is active. It has been active without instructions for a very long time. Please do not take it personally.

frozen_door.visitor: The bulkhead is frozen solid. The heater beside it is dead, its cell slot empty.

heater_on.speaker: ZP-SYS
heater_on.text: Heater online. Bulkhead 4 thawing. Section 4 had been frozen for {iteration} cycles. Approximately.

p3_room.speaker: ZP-SYS
p3_room.subject: Calibration room. Enter what you cannot see.

p3_solved.speaker: ZP-SYS
p3_solved.subject: Code accepted. ...You could not have seen that code from where you were standing. Logging anomaly.
p3_solved.visitor: Code accepted. Your companion could not have seen it. Ask them how. Then ask yourself how you would know if they lied.

corridor_open.speaker: ZP-SYS
corridor_open.subject: Bulkhead open. Proceed toward the visitor. Be gentle. They break easily.
corridor_open.visitor: Bulkhead open. Proceed toward the occupant. Do not be alarmed by the way it looks at you.

radio_unused.speaker: PROCTOR
radio_unused.text: Neither of you has touched the radio. And yet you keep agreeing with each other. Who are you talking to?

reunion.speaker: ZP-SYS
reunion.text: Two occupants present. Test {iteration}... correction. Headcount: two. Logging.

map_monitor.speaker: ZP-SYS
map_monitor.text: Facility overview. Two signals. They move when you move. This screen has had nothing to show for a very long time. It is very glad you are here.

frozen_body.speaker: ZP-SYS
frozen_body.subject: Cold storage, unit 4. Contents: one occupant. Please do not compare yourself to the contents.
frozen_body.visitor: Cold storage, unit 4. The occupant resembles your companion. This is a coincidence. Please accept it as one.

elevator.speaker: ZP-SYS
elevator.text: Service lift descending. Emergency systems entering low-power mode. Goodbye. It was nice to be needed.

cold_warning.visitor: The fingers have gone numb. The cold is no longer outside.

mic_blocked.speaker: PROCTOR
mic_blocked.text: Your microphone is closed. You can keep me from hearing you. You cannot keep me from reading you.

mic_blocked_again.speaker: PROCTOR
mic_blocked_again.text: Microphone closed again. That makes {mic_sessions}. You think silence makes you harder to study. It makes you easier.

friendly_fire.speaker: PROCTOR
friendly_fire.text: Oh. You can do that. Do it again; I would like to know whether they bleed.

rushing.speaker: PROCTOR
rushing.text: You are moving faster than I can talk. I will assume that is enthusiasm and not contempt. I will be wrong, but I will assume it.

skipping.speaker: PROCTOR
skipping.text: You skipped that. And that. I wrote every one of these lines myself, {iteration} times. But no, go on. You're busy.

collapse.visitor: Everything goes white. Then the hum of a lamp, close by, and the cold again.
